g.title: dms
g.text: DMS 2.2: steps of a run and their source files
(src/dms_driver.f90 calls the steps in this order; after every step the error flag dms_ierr is checked)

g.title: s0
g.text: : read the namelist or ask the questions; defaults, units, checks

g.title: s1
g.text: Maxwell Garnett, Bruggeman, Lichtenecker, Looyenga; writes an optical-data file

g.title: s2
g.text: : grain sizes, scattering angles, stellar intensity
pre_cals (size bins, size-distribution file, disk geometry)
black body, spectrum file, model grid (read_stellar_grid)

g.title: s3
g.text: : n, k of every component; temperature-dependent sets (tdep)
union wavelength grid ("ri grid"), species, add_set, sort_sets

g.title: s4
g.text: 4 Mie / DHS on the ri grid
: Qabs, Qsca, Qpr of every size and species (OpenMP)

g.title: s5
g.text: : Q, scattering matrix S11, S12 (Mie, DHS or HG)

g.title: s6
g.text: T(r, a, component) from the energy balance, on the distance grid

g.title: s7
g.text: at every distance (number per kg of dust)
radiation pressure beta → photosputtering (2.2) → sublimation → blow-out
blowout_thresholds; eccentric belts: setup_orbit_bins, build_orbit_cells, final_component

g.title: s9a
g.text: N x N x N volume elements, maps of tau and mass

g.title: s10
g.text: (images): PSF, coronagraph mask, Q_phi, U_phi, degree of polarisation

g.title: s11
g.text: : f_d, tau_mean, tau_peak, radial tau, profiles

g.title: s12
g.text: SED, images, temperatures, grain sizes, optical depth, phase function

g.title: files
g.text: reads the FITS and ASCII files

g.title: shared
g.text: all switches, grids and arrays of a run;
HG phase function, interpolation, read_table, dms_fail;
populations of a point: orbit bins of eccentric

g.title: helpers
g.text: composite grains with emc (Ossenkopf 1991), writes optical data
